name: Permafrost
description:
Calculates the CO2 and CH4 released as permafrost thaws with Arctic warming, following MAGICC7.

# What This Component Does

The permafrost region is divided into zonal bands, each holding mineral soil
and peat carbon. For each band and soil type:

1. Arctic warming above the band's melting threshold thaws frozen area
   (or refreezes thawed area when below it), moving carbon with the area
2. Thawed area splits into aerobic and anaerobic parts
3. Thawed carbon decomposes at Q10 and moisture dependent rates averaged over
   a seasonal soil temperature cycle
4. Aerobic decomposition releases CO2. Anaerobic decomposition releases equal
   parts CO2 and CH4, part of the CH4 being oxidised to CO2 in the soil

Emissions use the temperature at the start of the step and the mean of the
thawed pools before and after the step, as MAGICC7 does.
The emissions enter `CH4Chemistry`, `CH4Oxidation`, `OceanCarbon` and
`CO2Budget` when their `include_permafrost` parameter is set.

# Rounding sensitivity

A band that refreezes completely keeps thawed areas of rounding size, as in MAGICC7.
Carbon moved between them divides one rounding residue by another,
so emissions after such a refreeze depend on the last bits of the temperature.

inputs.name: Surface Air Temperature Change
inputs.description: Surface air temperature change at the start of the step, scaled to Arctic warming

outputs.name: Emissions|CO2|Permafrost
outputs.description: CO2 released from permafrost over the step

outputs.name: Emissions|CH4|Permafrost
outputs.description: CH4 released from permafrost over the step

outputs.name: Permafrost Thawed Area
outputs.description: Carbon-weighted thawed fraction at the end of the step

parameters.name: minimum_melting_temperature
parameters.description:
Arctic warming at which the southernmost band starts to thaw (MAGICC7 `PF_MELTINGTEMP_MIN`)

unit: K

parameters.name: maximum_melting_temperature
parameters.description:
Arctic warming at which the northernmost band starts to thaw (MAGICC7 `PF_MELTINGTEMP_MAX`)

unit: K

parameters.name: arctic_amplification
parameters.description:
Ratio of Arctic to global mean warming

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: soil_annual_cycle_amplitude
parameters.description:
Amplitude of the seasonal soil temperature cycle

unit: K

parameters.name: aerobic_turnover_time
parameters.description:
Turnover time of aerobic mineral soil decomposition at the Q10 reference

unit: yr

parameters.name: anaerobic_decomposition_ratio
parameters.description:
Anaerobic decomposition rate relative to aerobic

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: q10_temperature1
parameters.description:
Q10 reference temperature, LPJ `T1` (MAGICC7 `PF_Q10_TEMP1`)

unit: K

parameters.name: q10_temperature2
parameters.description:
Q10 offset temperature, LPJ `T2` (MAGICC7 `PF_Q10_TEMP2`)

unit: K

parameters.name: soil_water_slope
parameters.description:
Slope of soil moisture against soil temperature

unit: 1/K

parameters.name: soil_water_offset
parameters.description:
Soil moisture at the melting threshold

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: minimum_soil_water
parameters.description:
Lower bound of soil moisture (MAGICC7 `PF_SOILWATER_MINW`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: total_pool
parameters.description:
Total carbon in the permafrost region

unit: GtC

parameters.name: mineral_soil_fraction_south
parameters.description:
Mineral soil fraction of the carbon in the southernmost band

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: mineral_soil_fraction_north
parameters.description:
Mineral soil fraction of the carbon in the northernmost band

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: zonal_pool_distribution
parameters.description:
Shape of the zonal carbon distribution, from -1 (north heavy) to 1 (south heavy)

unit: dimensionless
